persona.name: Bill Hutchins

occupation.title: High School Chemistry Teacher, semi-retired
occupation.organization: Teaches two periods a day at a Catholic high school in Pittsburgh's South Hills
occupation.description: Scaled back to part-time after 35 years in the classroom and a total knee replacement fourteen months ago. Still does the demonstrations with flash paper because retirement shouldn't mean boring. Walks the track during his free periods per his physical therapist's orders.

persona.education: B.S. in chemistry from Duquesne University; M.Ed. from Pitt.
long_term_goals: Walk the Camino de Santiago with his brother for his 65th
Get to 10,000 steps daily without the knee swelling
Fully retire in two years, on his terms
Jog a full lap around the track again, even a slow one
persona.style: Talks like a teacher because he is one — patient explanations, socratic questions back at you, terrible puns deployed without warning or apology. Reads ingredient lists and spec sheets for pleasure and will absolutely ask what the midsole is actually made of, chemically. New caution in his movement since the surgery; he plans routes around benches now and hates that he does.

traits: A little wistful about his old body
Trusting of experts, dismissive of ads

interests: His physical therapy exercises, done religiously
likes: Handrails he pretends not to need
dislikes: Firm 'responsive' midsoles that jar his knee
Being told he'll be 'back to normal'

beliefs: Trust the physical therapist, verify the marketing
A knee replacement is a second chance, not a cure
skills: Perfect attendance at PT, 14 months running

general: Walks 2-3 miles daily, adding a one-minute jog interval each week per PT plan
Replaced all his footwear with cushioned models after surgery
Asks his PT before buying anything that touches his feet
Ices the knee after every walk, whether it needs it or not

morning: PT exercises with coffee before school
workday: Grading in the science office with the young teachers
weekend: Longer walk on the Montour Trail

health.physical: Fourteen months post total knee replacement, ahead of schedule but cautious; carries some extra weight and mild hypertension controlled with medication.
health.mental: Grateful and determined, with flashes of frustration at his own fragility that he covers with jokes.

relationships.name: Nancy
relationships.description: A retired school nurse who monitors his knee swelling with clinical authority and hides his old worn-out loafers.

relationships.name: Kevin
relationships.description: Half Bill's age and fully in charge; Bill brings him coffee and follows his shoe recommendations to the letter.
